resolutions.researcher_notes: The recorded value (Owner1 = 'DNP Ltd' 100%) disagrees with what independent sources say, so per the standing rule I am NOT proposing a ref to support it. DNP Limited (DNPL) is the joint-venture SPV that OPERATES the pipeline, but it does not own itself 100% -- it is jointly held by three parent companies. DNPL's own audited FY2024-25 annual report gives an explicit 'Shareholding Pattern as on 31-03-2025' table: Assam Gas Company Limited (AGCL) 51%, Numaligarh Refinery Limited (NRL) 26%, Oil India Limited (OIL) 23% (https://www.dnpl.co.in/assets/uploads/financial/annual-report-17669887791597877144.pdf, verified locally via pdftotext -- url_verifier false-negatives on this PDF). The identical 51/26/23 split also appears on DNPL's public profile page (https://www.dnpl.co.in/profile, url_verifier OK, 200 + '51'/'Assam Gas' present). This is the same finding already logged by this row's deep-sweep audit (batches/india-gas/staging/ref-sweep-operating/rows/P3310.json, validity concern_type='attribution'): Owner1 should be corrected to AGCL 51% / NRL 26% / OIL 23%, not sourced as 'DNP Ltd' 100%. Both corroborating documents originate from DNPL itself (marketing profile page + statutory annual report), so even for the corrected value this would only be tier=medium, not independent in the two-different-organisations sense -- no fully third-party source was found stating the ownership split (a market-database page, offshore-technology.com/GlobalData, names a fourth party 'Engineers India' as an owner but is demonstrably unreliable elsewhere on this row -- wrong length, 250 km vs 194/192 km -- so it is discounted). Routing the value correction to Update per the standing rule against proposing refs for a different value than recorded; leaving this unit UNRESOLVED rather than fabricating support for the sheet's current 'DNP Ltd' 100%.
